subject: Request: Demo - Redwood Inference — AE+SE + IT/Security
messages:
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>
To: signups@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Request: Demo - Redwood Inference

Hi Redwood team,

We signed up for a trial earlier today and would like to schedule a demo with an AE and SE to understand how Redwood would fit into our inference stack. Our IT/security team needs to join the session — please include Tom Reynolds (CISO) or someone from security.

High-level goals:
- Quick product overview and live demo (30-45 minutes)
- Security & compliance Q&A (SOC 2, network requirements)
- High-level pricing/throughput discussion

Availability (Eastern):
- Tue 7/28: 3:00-5:00pm EDT
- Wed 7/29: 10:00-11:30am EDT or 2:00-4:00pm EDT

If you could propose times that work for AE + SE + CISO (or provide a scheduling link) that would be great. Also, please send any security docs you can share up front.

Thanks,
Jordan Miles
Director of Platform Engineering
Acme Corp

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Demo - Redwood Inference

Ben / Marissa — inbound demo request from Acme (Jordan). They explicitly want IT/security on the call (Tom Reynolds). Jordan listed availability in EDT; I converted a couple of options below to PDT for our calendars.

Quick notes:
- Likely a 30-45 minute session: AE intro + SE deep dive + 10-15 minutes for security Q&A.
- Acme is evaluating for a multi-tenant inference use case (low-latency customer-facing features).
- I attached a starter mutual action plan and the prospect-provided security questionnaire.

Converted availability (PDT):
- Tue 7/28: 12:00-2:00pm PDT
- Wed 7/29: 7:00-8:30am PDT or 11:00am-1:00pm PDT

Suggested initial slots (my picks):
- Wed 7/29 11:30am PDT / 2:30pm EDT (30m) — AE + SE (+ optional IT)
- Wed 7/29 12:30pm PDT / 3:30pm EDT (45m) — AE + SE + IT (if needed)

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx; security-questions.pdf

Thanks — I can calendar the slot once you confirm.

—Aditya (SDR)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Demo - Redwood Inference

Jordan — thanks for signing up and for the context. Happy to run the demo with Marissa (SE) and have the security conversation with Tom on the same call. Agenda suggestion: 10m intro + 20m live demo (highlights: latency, batching, routing, private deployment options) + 20m SE/security Q&A.

Two options that work for our team (times shown with EDT / PDT / UTC conversions):
- Wed 7/29 3:30pm EDT / 12:30pm PDT / 19:30 UTC (45m)
- Thu 7/30 11:00am EDT / 8:00am PDT / 15:00 UTC (30-45m)

If neither works for Tom, let us know a couple of preferred slots and we'll do our best to accommodate. You can also pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/ben-car/30min

We'll include a short security packet in the invite — Marissa, I dropped the security questionnaire into the MAP attached; can you add the SOC2 summary and network/firewall notes?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 20:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: Demo - Redwood Inference

Thanks, Ben — appreciate the options. Heads up: Tom (CISO) is only available after 4:00pm EDT next week. The earliest we can do as a full group (AE + SE + CISO) is Tue 8/04 or Wed 8/05, 4:30-5:30pm EDT. If you can make one of those, that would be ideal. Otherwise we can do an AE+SE session first and then schedule a short follow-up with Tom.

Also please include any SOC 2 summary and network/firewall requirements in the invite — Tom will want to see that before the meeting.

Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 15:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: Demo - Redwood Inference

Jordan — thanks for the note and for adding Tom. Wed 8/05 4:30pm EDT works for me. That time converts to 1:30pm PDT / 20:30 UTC.

Proposed agenda (45 minutes):
- 5 min intros (Ben + Jordan + Tom + Sara)
- 20 min live demo (Marissa) — inference runtime, routing, batching, quantization options
- 15 min security + architecture Q&A (Tom + Marissa)
- 5 min next steps (MAP + trial plan)

I've attached an updated mutual action plan and our SOC 2 summary and a short network checklist. I’ll send a calendar invite with a calendar-attach (.ics) and include the MAP + SOC2 PDF.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx; redwood-soc2-summary.pdf; calendar-invite.ics

Ben — can you confirm and send the invite?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 16:00:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: Demo - Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — Wed 8/05 4:30pm EDT works for Tom and our team. Please send the calendar invite and include the attachments you mentioned. Looking forward to the demo.

Jordan Miles
Director of Platform Engineering, Acme Corp
